  "memo":"R01 holds: the established account has a recent email change and a newly linked device. Account access is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate device change with an email update and alternate shipping destination remains plausible. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check, implemented as a hold with contact through pre-change account details. No check has run, and the order is unshipped. Contact is the required and most decision-changing check; decline is not permitted on the current evidence."
